mapper.select: select id, finish_result_json from roam_session where member_id = #{memberId} and (location_cleared_at is null or last_lat is not null or last_lng is not null or track_json is not null) order by id
mapper.update: update roam_session set last_lat = null, last_lng = null, last_report_at = null, presence_visible = 0, track_json = null, finish_result_json = #{resultJson}, location_cleared_at = coalesce(location_cleared_at, #{now}) where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select distinct source_type, source_id from roam_shop_visit where member_id = #{memberId} and source_id is not null order by source_type, source_id
mapper.update: update roam_shop_visit set source_id = null, shop_name = '', claim_fingerprint = null where member_id = #{memberId} and (source_id is not null or claim_fingerprint is not null or shop_name <> '')
update roam_poi_found set poi_id = null, claim_fingerprint = null where member_id = #{memberId} and (poi_id is not null or claim_fingerprint is not null)

update roam_poi_reward_log set trigger_lat = null, trigger_lng = null, claim_fingerprint = null, poi_id = case when coalesce(coupon_id, 0) = 0 then null else poi_id end where member_id = #{memberId} and (trigger_lat is not null or trigger_lng is not null or claim_fingerprint is not null or (coalesce(coupon_id, 0) = 0 and poi_id is not null))
update roam_territory_checkin set owner_member_id = 0 where owner_member_id = #{memberId}
update city_game_board_audit set actor_id = null, detail_json = case when action = 'BOARD_TERRITORY_CLAIM' then null else detail_json end where actor_type = 'PLAYER' and actor_id = #{memberId}
